<td>Effective Policies Service Agent

<p>Give effective policy service account access to search all resources and IAM policies.</p>
<blockquote>
<strong>Warning:</strong> Do not grant service agent roles to any principals except <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/iam/docs/service-agents">service agents</a> .
</blockquote></td>

</tr>
<tr class="even">

<p>( <code>roles/ cloudasset.serviceAgent</code> )</p>

<blockquote>
<strong>Warning:</strong> Do not grant service agent roles to any principals except <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/iam/docs/service-agents">service agents</a> .
</blockquote></td>
